dct_description_sm:
Overview

This feature service provides a municipal planning layer for the Hillside Development Permit Area in Peachland. It represents the area designated for hillside development permit oversight and supports land use review, development planning, and geographic reference within the District of Peachland.

Layer

Hillside Development Permit Area (PCH) contains polygon features that define the permit area boundary associated with hillside planning and development regulations. The layer includes a name attribute for identifying the area and standard feature identifiers for GIS use.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers The District of Peachland within the Regional District of Central Okanagan

Use Cases

  • Planning and development permit administration
  • Land use review and environmental screening
  • Municipal and regional mapping
  • Public reference for hillside development areas

Source and Use Information
